implementation: Retain one checkpoint capability per authenticated session scope; every existing inspect boundary remains fresh.
Retain the local push integration capability; each observation rechecks effective filters rather than accepting a newly constructed context.
Read an equal source/target ref once inside one synchronous inspection; do not reuse observations across calls or awaits.

scope.source_kind: frozen-source diagnostic using real application and Git ports

limits: One baseline run under current machine load is descriptive, not a causal performance estimate.
The baseline completed; it does not locate expiration in an older immutable failed case.
TTL, grants, plans, budgets and existing effects are unchanged.
Frozen baseline and composed acknowledgement-loss runs retain their exact source; future source is separately qualified.

retained_binding_counterexample.scope: independent disposable Git diagnostic, not workflow qualification
retained_binding_counterexample.observation: A redirected gitfile retained the old index hash while fresh construction observed a distinct index; cached identity stayed unchanged.
retained_binding_counterexample.resolution: Each retained port re-resolves and compares its original physical gitdir/index binding before inspection. Changed bindings refuse; they are never silently adopted.
